Tatsugiri

Dragon Water

Paldea · Generation 9

Tatsugiri is a Dragon/Water-type Mimicry Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 8 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (120), with a base stat total of 475.
